meta.description: Coal import and coastal-shipping ports serving Indian (especially Tamil Nadu) thermal plants: terminals, the TN plants each serves, and approximate sea lanes.
meta.coords: WGS84. Each record has loc_precision. Terminal coordinates come from Global Energy Monitor (GEM) wiki where marked; port points from Wikipedia or OSM.
meta.sea_lanes_note: approximate illustrative route through hand-picked open-sea waypoints, densified along great circles; NOT a vessel track. Real routing varies with ship size, season and charter.
meta.tn_coal_flow_fy22: MoC ICLP (Jan 2024): FY22 Odisha to Tamil Nadu coal was 28.12 Mt, of which 26.30 Mt went rail-sea-rail, 1.16 Mt rail and 0.66 Mt road.

licences.GEM wiki: Global Energy Monitor, CC BY 4.0 (per GEM terms; verify before redistribution)

ports.name: Kamarajar Port (Ennore)
ports.operator: Kamarajar Port Ltd (Chennai Port Authority owned)
ports.notes: Built as a satellite of Chennai Port primarily for TNEB thermal coal; first coal unloaded 22-Jun-2001. Hosts TNPGCL/NTECL captive coal berths feeding NCTPS, Vallur and (via rail from the NCTPS yard) Mettur.

terminals.name: Coal Berth 1 (CB-1)
terminals.evacuation: conveyor to NCTPS coal yard; onward rail rakes from NCTPS yard to Mettur (and formerly Ennore TPS)

terminals.name: Coal Berth 2 (CB-2)
terminals.evacuation: 4.4 km pipe conveyor (4,000 t/h) across Ennore Creek to Vallur TPP

terminals.name: Coal Berth 3 (CB-3)
terminals.evacuation: shore unloaders (2 x 2,600 t/h, up to 120,000 DWT) and conveyors to Ennore SEZ (Vayalur) project, with connection to NCTPS

terminals.name: Ennore Coal Terminal (ex-Chettinad International Coal Terminal), JSW Infrastructure
terminals.operator: Ennore Coal Terminal Pvt Ltd (JSW Infrastructure)
terminals.evacuation: common-user import terminal (coal, coke, limestone); road/rail to private users

ports.name: Chennai Port
ports.notes: TNEB coal handling moved to Ennore (Kamarajar) after 2001; Madras High Court ordered on 11-May-2011 that coal/iron ore handling stop (shifted to Ennore from 1-Oct-2011); Supreme Court allowed resumption with conditions in Sept 2012 but the port ceased coal handling in Oct 2012. Included for history only.

ports.name: V.O. Chidambaranar Port (Tuticorin / Thoothukudi)
ports.notes: Wikipedia's infobox coordinate for this port (8.4730 N, 78.1215 E) is wrong (about 30 km south of the harbour), so the OSM harbour node is used. Coal is handled at Coal Jetties I & II (captive, for TTPS), NCB-I (captive, NTPL), NCB-II (common user) and NCB-III (JSW multipurpose).

terminals.name: Coal Jetties I & II (TTPS captive)
terminals.evacuation: conveyor to Tuticorin TPS (plant sits on port land in the Harbour Estate)

terminals.name: North Cargo Berth I (NCB-I), NTPL captive
North Cargo Berth II (NCB-II), common user

ports.name: Udangudi captive offshore coal jetty (Kallamozhi)
ports.notes: Offshore jetty about 8 km off the Kallamozhi coast built by ITD Cementation for Udangudi Stage-I. MoC logistics plan: Chandrabila block coal railed about 200 km to Paradip, then 1,224 nautical miles by sea to this jetty.

ports.name: ITPCL captive jetty (Parangipettai / C. Pudupettai, Cuddalore) - under construction
ports.loc_precision: approx: unnamed OSM pier (way 1305008985) next to the ITPCL site; identification inferred
ports.status: under construction (IL&FS investment teaser, Nov 2023: about 50% complete)
ports.notes: Until the jetty is finished, ITPCL's imported coal is handled at Karaikal Port, about 133 km away, and railed on Indian Railways to a 5 km captive siding (IL&FS teaser, Nov 2023). ITPCL holds a coal CCOW licence at Upau, South Kalimantan, Indonesia.

ports.name: Karaikal Port (Puducherry UT)
ports.operator: Karaikal Port Pvt Ltd (developed by MARG group)
ports.notes: Handles coal and pet coke and sends 4-5 coal rakes a day. Imported coal for ITPCL (Cuddalore) is unloaded here and railed about 133 km to the plant (IL&FS teaser, Nov 2023). Nearest port to Nagai TPP (Okkur, about 9 km per GEM); CEA lists Nagai as RAIL-SEA-ROAD with loading- and unloading-port stocks. The Karaikal-Nagai link is inferred, not confirmed.

ports.name: Kattupalli Port (Adani)
ports.notes: Coal is not among this port's approved cargoes (EC for berths 4-5, Mar 2025). Listed only because it sits next to Kamarajar.

ports.name: Paradip Port
role: loading: MCL Talcher/Ib Valley coal for coastal shipping (RSR)
ports.notes: Main loading port for Tamil Nadu's domestic coal. FY22 MCL RSR despatch via Paradip was 24.84 Mt, including 10.92 Mt for TANGEDCO, 4.27 Mt for NTECL Vallur and 0.97 Mt for NTPL. Coal terminals: Mechanised Coal Handling Plant (MCHP), East Quay coal terminal, Kalinga International Coal Terminal (import) and Western Dock.
rail_feed: Talcher coalfield -> Talcher Rd/Budhapank -> Rajathgarh -> Cuttack -> Haridaspur -> Paradeep
Ib Valley -> Jharsuguda -> Sambalpur -> Angul -> Talcher Rd -> Paradeep

ports.name: Visakhapatnam Port
role: loading: MCL coal for coastal shipping
ports.notes: FY22: 2.5 Mt of TANGEDCO's MCL coal was loaded here (MoC ICLP). Coal terminals: EQ1, EQ1A, Vizag Seaport (EQ8/EQ9) and Vizag General Cargo Berth (Vedanta).

ports.name: Gangavaram Port (Adani)
role: candidate loading port for MCL coastal coal (ICLP)
ports.notes: Handled about 8 Mt of Panamax coal in 2024 (Breakwave Advisors). The MoC ICLP lists it among the east-coast ports to be explored for coastal shipping.

ports.name: Haldia Dock Complex (Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port)
role: historical/occasional loading port for ECL/MCL coal to TN
ports.notes: Historically one of three TNEB loading ports (Haldia, Paradip, Vizag). Haldia has mechanised coal berths 2, 3, 4 and 4A.

ports.name: Krishnapatnam Port (Adani)
role: unloading: RSR coal for AP plants
ports.notes: Unloading port for MCL RSR coal to Rayalaseema TPS, Sri Damodaram Sanjeevaiah TPS and Sembcorp's Painampuram & SGPL (FY22 ICLP). Handled about 11 Mt of Panamax coal in 2024.

ports.name: Mundra Port (Adani)
role: import: coal for Adani Mundra TPP and Tata Mundra UMPP

terminals.name: Mundra West Basin Coal Terminal (WB1-WB4, about 60 Mtpa)

ports.notes: Mundra UMPP (CGPL, Tata Power) and Adani Power Mundra run on imported coal (CEA monthly statement: 100% import).

foreign_loading_ports.name: South Kalimantan coal anchorages (Taboneo / Banjarmasin), Indonesia
foreign_loading_ports.loc_precision: approx: Banjarmasin city point (Wikipedia); Taboneo transhipment anchorage lies offshore to the SW

foreign_loading_ports.name: East Kalimantan coal ports (Samarinda / Balikpapan area), Indonesia
Richards Bay Coal Terminal, South Africa

tn_plant_port_map.note: Domestic linkage is SCCL (Telangana), about 606 km by all-rail (CEA mode RAIL). Imported coal (1.45 Mtpa MoU with MMTC) comes through Kamarajar.
